abstract: Partially spoofed audio embeds spoofed segments in a bonafide utterance, and spoof localization is the task of locating them. Most countermeasures (CMs) operate at the frame level. Typically, they include a front-end representing the audio as frames and a back-end classifying each frame as bonafide or spoof. Such frame-level detection ties the reference, the predictions and the evaluation to a pre-defined temporal resolution: a frame containing a transition receives a single label, a boundary cannot lie inside a frame, and the evaluation also depends on the resolution. To tackle these issues, we treat spoof localization as regression. We propose a single-stage boundary regressor that outputs (start-time, end-time, score) tuples with continuous-valued time stamps, trained on the exact reference intervals. Results show that the proposed CM outperforms previous frame-level and boundary-based CMs, and generalizes better.

oneSentenceThesis: 针对帧级分类受 20 ms 分辨率束缚而无法输出帧内边界的问题，论文提出单阶段连续边界回归并以精确区间训练，在 PartialSpoof 上以最大融合取得最低点式与区间式等错误率且跨库泛化更好，代价是依赖精确标注并需 Soft-NMS 后处理且整句全伪造存在任务错位。
